pain.title: You need 90% to pass the CSCS test
pain.text: The CITB operatives test has 50 questions in 45 minutes and you need at least 45 right. That leaves room for only 5 mistakes across site rules, health risks, equipment, signs and high risk work. Visual maps help you see each topic at a glance and remember the details.
pain.source: CITB: the pass mark for the Operatives test is 90% (45 out of 50 questions).

items.a: The CITB health, safety and environment (HS&E) test for operatives: the CITB test for general site workers, and a key part of getting a CSCS card. It is not for the managers and professionals test.

This is version {version}. Each map is checked against HSE guidance or the law, and the date of the check is printed on every page ({checkedOn}). When the rules change, we update the PDFs and you get the new version free.
No. It's an independent revision guide based on HSE guidance and health and safety law. All the practice questions are our own, not taken from the CITB question bank or revision book.

items.q: Does it replace a training course?
items.a: No. It helps you revise for the test. Your employer must still give you the training and information you need for your job.
Right after you pay, Hotmart emails you your access to the members area, where you download the PDFs.
Yes. Every map is an A4 page, made to print at home.

items.q: Does it work on my phone?
items.a: Yes, the PDFs open on any device. They're designed for A4, so on a phone you zoom in. The flashcards also come in a phone version.
No. They're high-resolution PDFs for your personal use.
Yes. You have {guaranteeDays} days from your purchase to ask for a full refund through Hotmart, no questions asked.
